title: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average run
question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(SUM(bs.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT bs.match_id), 2) AS batting_average
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
 AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
 AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
 AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = b.match_id
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.striker
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;
